basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 Plant Operator, Lab Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Project Manager, Project Engineer, Associate Project Engineer, Assistant Project Engineer, Plant Operator, Lab Assistant, Lab Attendant
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

qualification.details: Essential: one of the following: B.E./B. Tech in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline, with a minimum of 8 years of relevant industrial or research-based project management experience M.Tech/M.Sc. in the above disciplines, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in R&D, industrial projects, or technology development PhD in a related field, with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, including management of research-driven technology projects Skills and experience: minimum 2 years of experience in project management, preferably involving R&D or industrial projects, industrial process development, pilot plant development, or technology demonstration. Experience in project planning, execution, procurement, vendor coordination, budget monitoring, and technical reporting, along with strong leadership, organisational, and communication skills. Preferred: knowledge of pyrolysis, thermochemical conversion, or related technologies, with 2 years of relevant experience. Software skills: proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with Aspen Plus/MATLAB/Modelica, AutoCAD, or equivalent engineering software. The notice also lists PMP with experience in technology commercialisation, intellectual property management, technology transfer, or coordination of pilot-scale industrial projects. | Essential: PhD in Engineering/Technology; or Master's degree with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience; or Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience, preferably in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related disciplines. Required skills: good knowledge of AI/ML, data analytics, and predictive modelling, with experience in experimental, sensor, or industrial data analysis. Proficiency in Python, data pre-processing, feature engineering, statistical analysis, and basic machine learning model development is required, along with good analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills. Work: developing and validating predictive models for reactor performance, product yield, quality, and energy consumption, and contributing to DSS development for process optimisation. Desirable: familiarity with time-series analysis, model validation, uncertainty assessment, software development, and laboratory/pilot-scale data integration; knowledge of SciPy, MATLAB, TensorFlow/PyTorch, and DSS development tools. Added advantage: knowledge of advanced optimisation, physics-informed modelling, explainable AI, digital twins, and PLC/SCADA integration. Software skills: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn), statistical analysis, data visualisation, and MS Office. | Essential: Master's degree in Engineering/Technology or Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, preferably in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Production, Energy, Environmental, or related disciplines. Preferred: experience in material characterisation, product-quality evaluation, interpretation of analytical results, and preparation of technical reports. Desirable: experience in pyrolysis, biomass conversion, data analysis, and process improvement. Skills: ability to support experimental activities and coordinate effectively with operators, laboratory staff, and project personnel. Software skills: MATLAB, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, MS Office, and data-analysis tools. | Essential: Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering. Skills: basic understanding of chemical engineering principles, process operations, and industrial equipment. Desirable: familiarity with process monitoring, sampling, data recording, equipment inspection, basic troubleshooting, safety practices, and technical documentation, gained through academic projects, laboratory work, or internships; basic knowledge of MATLAB, MS Office, and data-analysis tools. | Essential: ITI or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Instrumentation, Production Engineering, or a related discipline. Preferred: a minimum of 2 years of experience. Desirable: experience in reactor, furnace, boiler, thermal-processing, or pilot-plant operation. Skills: knowledge of electrical panels and process equipment, and of start-up, shutdown, emergency procedures, PPE, fire safety, and high-temperature operations. Work: operating continuous and batch pyrolysis reactors in rotational shifts, including feeding, discharge, sampling, storage, start-up, shutdown, safety, and shift-record maintenance. | Essential: 10th/12th, ITI, or Diploma in a relevant discipline. Preferred: laboratory or industrial experience, with a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience. | Essential: 10th/12th, ITI, or Diploma in a relevant discipline. Preferred: laboratory or industrial experience. | Previous experience in laboratory or industrial environments is desirable. Knowledge of good laboratory practices, safety procedures, material handling, waste segregation, and spill management. Ability to maintain laboratory and pilot-plant cleanliness; clean glassware, tools, and equipment; receive, label, arrange, and store materials and samples; and maintain housekeeping and activity checklists. The candidate should be physically capable of routine material handling and laboratory support activities. | Check the official notification (PDF) for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

selection_process: Selection will be based on the candidate's performance in the interview
which will be held online through Google Meet. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email
and application status can also be seen on the application portal.
how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati.
Search for the project title: "Design and Development of a Demonstration Plant for Production of Marketable Grade Green Activated Carbon from Bamboo Dust".
Open the relevant position and follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.
Submit the online application on or before 4 November 2026, 5:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the candidate's performance in the interview, which will be held online through Google Meet. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email, and application status can also be seen on the application portal.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The duration of appointment is 11 months for each of the seven posts.

faq.question: Q1. Which IIT Guwahati posts accept 10th or 12th candidates?
faq.answer: Lab Assistant and Lab Attendant both accept 10th/12th, ITI, or Diploma in a relevant discipline. Experience is listed as preferred for these two posts.

faq.question: Q2. How much experience does a Project Manager need?
faq.answer: It depends on the degree: a minimum of 8 years with B.E./B. Tech, 5 years with M.Tech/M.Sc., or 2 years with a PhD, in the type of work specified for each route.

faq.question: Q3. Can a Chemical Engineering graduate without work experience apply for Assistant Project Engineer?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, and the notice sets no minimum years of experience for this post. Familiarity gained through academic projects, laboratory work, or internships is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Does the Plant Operator post involve shift work?
faq.answer: Yes. The Plant Operator needs the ability to run continuous and batch pyrolysis reactors in rotational shifts.

faq.question: Q5. How do I find these posts on the recruitment portal?
faq.answer: Search for the project title given in the advertisement, which begins "Design and Development of a Demonstration Plant". The relevant position can be accessed from there.

faq.question: Q6. Do I need to travel to Guwahati for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview mode is online and the venue is Google Meet. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the test or interview.

faq.question: Q7. How will I know if I am shortlisted?
faq.answer: IIT Guwahati will inform shortlisted candidates by email. You can also see your application status on the application portal.

faq.question: Q8. Whom can I contact about the application?
faq.answer: For technical help with the online application, email [email protected]. For any other clarification, contact the Principal Investigator, Prof. Senthilmurugan Subbiah, at [email protected] or +91 361 258 3527.
